sources.title: Status of Approved Projects under AMRUT 2.0 in Andhra Pradesh (as on 05.03.2026), GVMC water-body rejuvenation rows S.no 44-54; and MoHUA's live AMRUT 2.0 project list for GVMC, checked 14 Oct 2026 (Rajupalem and Thimmaraju Tank rows)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
sources.license: Government of India publication, cited with attribution

provenance.note: The 11 GVMC water-body projects in MoHUA's AMRUT 2.0 status list for Andhra Pradesh as on 5 March 2026: Rs 23.31 crore in all, 10 completed, one being implemented. Per-record sources carry the citation.

note: Visakhapatnam's dated, budgeted lake work is the AMRUT 2.0 water-body component: 11 GVMC tanks, Rs 23.31 crore, 10 marked completed in MoHUA's 5 March 2026 list. MoHUA's live list (checked 14 Oct 2026) also shows a 12th, Rajupalem tank in the Anakapalli division of GVMC, Rs 2.00 crore at DPR stage; it is not in the 5 March list and is not carried here. Proposals without a sanction (the ponds and sponge parks proposed in the draft Green City Action Plan, prepared by the IFC for GVMC and posted by GVMC for comment on 19 Oct 2024) are not programmes and are left out. Flagship cards come from GVMC's own documents for the ADB (three initial environmental examinations and a resettlement due-diligence report, 2018-2019), the draft Green City Action Plan, the National Register of Large Dams, APWRIMS, CPCB lake monitoring, filings to the National Green Tribunal, RINL's 2018 filing to MoEFCC, VMRDA's draft master plan (2021), CGWB's 2025 aquifer plan, the MoEFCC wetlands portal and the 1907 district gazetteer, with conflicting figures shown side by side. No list of lost tanks is shown: we have not found a published official one.
_court_orders_note: Empty. We have not found a court or tribunal order about a Visakhapatnam lake or tank to this file's standard (court, case number, date and the order or a primary report of it). The NGT's public judgment search offers a date range and a captcha only, with no party or keyword search, so this is a gap in what could be searched, not a finding that no case exists.

projects.scheme_name: Rejuvenation of water body at Thungalam (AMRUT 2.0)
projects.scope: Rejuvenation of the water body at Thungalam, one of the 11 GVMC tanks in the water-body component of AMRUT 2.0 (MoHUA project AP-GVMC-8818). MoHUA's live AMRUT 2.0 project list for GVMC (checked 14 Oct 2026) has no Thungalam row. It has 12 GVMC water-body projects, Rs 25.31 crore in all: ten of the 5 March tanks under the same names and costs (Rs 22.04 crore), a new Rs 2.00 crore Rajupalem project and, in place of Thungalam, a Rs 1.27 crore 'Thimmaraju Tank' project at Contract Awarded. This appears to be the same project under a new name; MoHUA's live list has no project IDs and does not say so.
